main.title: TOKIMEKI Poll
main.detail: Create polls and vote on them, and delete your own polls and votes.

detail:lang.ja: 投票の作成と投票への参加、自分の投票や票の削除

description: Permission set for TOKIMEKI Poll: creating polls and voting on them. Any client can request it as the OAuth scope include:tech.tokimeki.poll.authFull. It covers the tech.tokimeki.poll.* records only; a client that also writes the post a poll is attached to requests that separately (e.g. repo:app.bsky.feed.post?action=create, and blob:image/* for a thumbnail).
